easy.def: A thought about what to do.
examples: I have an idea! Let's build a fort.
It was my idea to make a card.
That is a good idea!

more.def: A thought, plan, or picture that forms in your mind.
examples: Her idea for the science fair was to build a tiny windmill.
Do you have any ideas for the class party?
The idea for the story came to her in a dream.

easy.def: To not pay attention to something.
examples: Ignore the noise and keep reading.
The cat ignores me when I call.
Do not ignore the stop sign.

more.def: To pay no attention to someone or something on purpose.
examples: He ignored the ringing phone and finished his homework.
She ignored the teasing and kept playing.
If you ignore a small leak, it can become a big problem.

easy.def: To draw pictures for a story.
examples: I will illustrate my book with crayons.
She illustrates books for kids.
We illustrate our poems.

more.def: To add pictures to a book or story, or to explain with examples.
examples: The artist illustrated the story with bright watercolor paintings.
He illustrated his report with maps and photos.
The teacher used a story to illustrate her point.

easy.def: To make a picture in your mind.
examples: Imagine you can fly like a bird!
I imagine I am a pirate.
Can you imagine a pink elephant?

more.def: To form a picture or idea in your mind of something that is not in front of you.
examples: Try to imagine what our town looked like one hundred years ago.
Imagine how cold it must be at the North Pole.
I cannot imagine life without music.
It is important to wash your hands.
It is important to be kind.
Sleep is important for kids.

more.def: Having great value or meaning; mattering a lot.
examples: Getting enough sleep is important for staying healthy.
The mayor has an important job in our town.
It is important to look both ways before you cross.

easy.def: Not able to happen or be done.
examples: It is impossible to touch the moon.
It is impossible to count all the stars.
The knot was impossible to undo.

more.def: Not able to be done or to happen.
examples: It seemed impossible to finish the puzzle, but we did it.
The heavy snow made it impossible to drive.
Nothing is impossible if you keep trying, said the coach.
I practice to improve my drawing.
My reading improves each week.
We can improve the fort with a roof.

more.def: To make something better or to become better.
examples: Her reading improved after she practiced every night.
The weather improved in the afternoon.
He added salt to improve the taste of the soup.

easy.def: To make someone or something a part of a group.
examples: Please include me in your game.
The lunch includes an apple.
We include everyone in our club.

more.def: To have as a part, or to make something part of a group.
examples: The price of the ticket includes a drink and a snack.
The tour includes a visit to the castle.
Be sure to include your name on your paper.

easy.def: A small bug with six legs.
examples: An ant is an insect.
A bee is an insect that can sting.
The insect sat on a leaf.

more.def: A small animal with six legs and a body in three parts, often with wings.
examples: Bees, ants, and butterflies are all insects.
Some insects, like crickets, make sounds with their wings.
An insect's body has three main parts.

easy.def: A thing you play to make music.
examples: A drum is an instrument.
What instrument do you play?
A flute is an instrument you blow.

more.def: An object used to make music; also, a tool for careful work.
examples: The violin is her favorite instrument to play.
Every instrument in the band plays a different part.
The dentist used a small instrument to check my teeth.

easy.def: To stop someone when they are talking or busy.
examples: Please do not interrupt me.
Do not interrupt when I am on the phone.
The bell interrupted our game.

more.def: To stop someone while they are speaking or doing something.
examples: A loud knock interrupted the teacher in the middle of the story.
Sorry to interrupt, but dinner is ready.
A power cut interrupted the movie.

easy.def: To make something that no one has made before.
examples: I want to invent a robot that cleans my room.
She invented a new game.
Who invented the bike?

more.def: To think of and create something new for the first time.
examples: People invented the wheel thousands of years ago.
He invented a machine that feeds the cat.
The children invented a secret code for their notes.
I will invite my friends to my party.
Our teacher invited a vet to class.
Invite your sister to play.

more.def: To ask someone to come somewhere or to do something with you.
examples: We invited our new neighbors over for dinner.
The neighbors invited us to their barbecue.
She was invited to speak at the meeting.

easy.def: Land with water all around it.
examples: We took a boat to the island.
The island has a sandy beach.
Birds live on the small island.

more.def: A piece of land that is completely surrounded by water.
examples: Hawaii is made up of many islands in the Pacific Ocean.
The only way to reach the island is by ferry.
They built a hut on the island in the middle of the lake.
